messages:
ana: quick sync / follow-up to the quant RFC: we prototyped a lightweight 'activation-density' probe to steer between fp8/int8/4bit at routing time. posting notes + rollout questions.

mike: drop the micro results pls. is probe deterministic per request?

devon: probe = single-token forward on layer 1 (configurable N tokens, default 1) sampling every request when cache miss. compute density = count(abs(act) > tau) / N_elems. tau default 1e-3.

ana: note: we ALSO support sampling from kv-cache snapshots for warmed sessions to avoid extra forward. fallback to live probe if cache absent.

kira: what thresholds map to paths? need explicit mapping so routing code is simple.

ana: suggested map: density <= 0.22 -> int8-4bit lane; 0.22 < d <= 0.5 -> fp8-fast; d > 0.5 -> fp8-calib or fp16. exact numbers in profile.

mike: how do we prevent hint abuse? clients could set density_hint low and get cheap path even if model outputs degrade.

devon: policy: runtime checks hint vs probe. if |hint - probe| > 0.12 -> ignore hint and tag event "hint_mismatch". allow a small hysteresis window to avoid flipflop on borderline.

ana: quality safety: each endpoint will have a rolling degscore. if path selection causes avg degscore delta > 0.015 vs baseline in the last 1h -> trigger auto-fallback to safer path and alert.

kira: what is degscore exactly in this context?

devon: degscore = fraction of token-level semantic regressions per eval harness, normalized per-endpoint. we already have this for canaries. we'll reuse same metric.

ana: instrumentation we need: "density_probe_value", "probe_source" (live|cache), "hint_provided", "hint_used", "selected_lane", "degscore_delta", "fallback_reason". send per-request, but sample at 1/10 for high-volume endpoints.

mike: perf impact? p99 penalty?

devon: bench: median +0.35ms, p99 +0.9ms for short requests when probe runs. when using cached snapshot -> negligible.

ana: rollout plan:
1) internal-only model group for 48h (all test traffic) to validate histograms.
2) create canary slice per endpoint (2% traffic) for 72h with alerts on degscore > 0.01.
3) widen to 20% if stable, then GA opt-in.

kira: ops/infra asks: can we gate probe by node label? we want pilot nodes with probe enabled to isolate perf impact.

infra-bot: pilot nodes created: label=quant-probe=true, cluster=canary-3 -> deployed at 1789994500 by infra-team :white_check_mark:

mike: config shape for quant_profile? show minimal JSON example pls.

ana: example (1-line JSON in message): `{"id":"den-v2","base":"fp8","density_metric":"activation_fraction","thresholds":{"low":0.22,"mid":0.5},"probe_tokens":1,"tau":0.001,"hint_policy":"validate","hint_delta_allow":0.12}`

kira: what about per-layer vs global? we should start global and add per-layer overrides in model-specific profiles for experiments.

devon: agree. per-layer probes double cost and complexity. enable only behind model opt-in flag.

mike: concerns about increased billing if attackers force higher-precision lanes?

an a: mitigate: rate-limit hints, trust-but-verify, and per-customer budget guards. enterprise contracts can pin to profile too.

kira: testing checklist before PR: unit tests for hint validation, synthetic load test for p99, integration tests with degscore harness, telemetry retention checks.

ana: will open PR with schema changes + probe impl + telemetry + canary job. tagging @devon for review.

infra-bot: canary job scheduled: quant-density-probe-canary-178999 -> started at 1789994700

mike: thanks. add an ops runbook item: "how to disable probe per-endpoint" (quick toggle) so oncall can respond fast.

ana: added to PR checklist. i'll paste the runbook snippet in PR description.

kira: LGTM in principle. once PR lands i'll run the degscore harness on the canary cluster.

ana: thanks all. i'll post PR link when ready.
